description:
FREE. Verifies an audit receipt against its record (re-hashes the submitted action + context, checks they and actor_metadata match the receipt, plus the Ed25519 signature).
USE WHEN you have an audit receipt + the original action/metadata and need to confirm the record is genuine and unaltered.
RETURNS: { valid, details }. valid is true only if action, context, AND actor_metadata all match the receipt AND the signature is valid. A 200 means verification ran — always read valid (false = record altered or receipt forged).

action.description: The action the receipt was issued for.

actor_metadata.description: The actor_metadata the receipt was issued for.

context.description: The optional context the receipt was issued for (omit if none).

receipt.description: An audit receipt as returned by audit_action.

name: verify_audit

details.description: Per-check breakdown (e.g. hash match, signature valid).

valid.description: True only if the content/record matches the receipt AND the Ed25519 signature is valid.

title: Verify an audit receipt
